title: Ya Rab Mere Dardan Da Koi Te Sila Day
body:
Main Ujri Sakina Nu (x2)
Mera Baba Mila Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Jandi Haan Veeran
Abid Teri Majburi
Nahi Kohi Gila Menu
Kar Rasm Dafan Puri
Bahvain Rawan Dey Vich Meri (x2)
Tu Qabr Bana Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Jeewain Paak Nabi Keethi
Tazeem Fatima Di
Ainj Jaan Ton Hay Pyaari
Menu Meri Sakina Vi
Chau Salan Di Zahra Nu (x2)
Na Shimr Saza Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Masoom Behan Meri
Zindan Da Hanera
Kar Yaad Mar Na Javay
Beemar Veer Tera
Keevain Vakhri Qaid Teri (x2)
Sajjad Bhula Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Nahi Maut Kolon Dardi
Sehlangi Main Sazawan
Ik Vaar Miley Baba
Bahwain Fir Main Marjavan
Parwardigar Menu (x2)
Kuj Dayr Bachavay
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad Hath Uthakay
Mangdi Raway Duawan
Kohi Yateem Howay
Na Qaidi Hon Mawan
Odha Vain Shaam Wala (x2)
Zindan Hila Day
